target_milestone: Step 18: Security, Integration and End-to-End Testing

authentication.evidence: Bcrypt password hashing (cost 12), JWT HS256 tokens with expiry & claims, /auth/register, /auth/login, /auth/me verified. 8/8 tests pass.

api_key_management.evidence: CSPRNG keys (secrets.token_urlsafe), SHA-256 hex hashes in DB (zero plaintext storage), prefixing, revocation lifecycle verified. 3/3 tests pass.

subscriptions_and_plans.evidence: 3 tiers (Free, Pro, Enterprise), 30-day period constraints, auto-provisioning Free tier on register verified. 7/7 tests pass.

usage_metering.evidence: Access log ingestion with status codes, latency ms, response bytes, source_record_key deduplication, /usage/summary and /usage/events verified. 4/4 tests pass.

redis_rate_limiting.evidence: Sliding window log (ZSET) and token bucket algorithms, tier limits (60, 300, 1200 req/min), RFC headers, HTTP 429 Retry-After, and fakeredis fallback verified. 4/4 tests pass.

quota_enforcement.evidence: Monthly quota checks (10k, 100k, 1M), X-Quota-Warning header at >=80%, hard quota HTTP 429 cut-off verified via QuotaService and middleware.

daily_aggregation.evidence: Background rollup worker aggregating usage_events into usage_daily with ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE idempotency. 724 daily records upserted from 1,000 events in 1,804 ms. 2/2 tests pass.

billing_and_invoicing.evidence: Preview calculation, monthly invoice generation with line items and tiered overage fees, sequential INV-YYYYMM-XXXX numbers, payment settlement verified. 4/4 tests pass.

payment_gateway_and_webhooks.evidence: Razorpay Test Mode order creation, Decimal to minor units conversion, HMAC-SHA256 signature verification, webhook idempotency, late failure reversal protection, refund handling verified. 17/17 tests pass.

password_hashing.details: Bcrypt cost factor 12 with per-user salt.

secret_management.details: Zero plaintext API keys stored; environment variables with .env.example templates; secrets excluded from API responses.

sql_injection_defense.details: 100% parameterized SQLAlchemy 2.0 ORM queries and text binds.

timing_attack_resistance.details: Constant-time comparisons via hmac.compare_digest and secrets.compare_digest.

public_auth_rate_limiting.details: Rate limiting is active on API Gateway (/gateway/*) and X-API-Key routes, but public login/registration endpoints lack IP-based brute-force throttling.

security_headers.details: OWASP security headers (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Strict-Transport-Security, CSP) are not yet injected in global middleware.

test_isolation.details: Tests run against active development database with unique UUIDs rather than an isolated ephemeral test database fixture.

integration_gaps_and_blockers.description: Public authentication endpoints (/api/v1/auth/login, /api/v1/auth/register) lack IP-based rate limiting, leaving them susceptible to credential stuffing.
integration_gaps_and_blockers.remediation: Extend RateLimiter middleware or dependency to throttle auth endpoints by client IP (e.g. 10 requests / minute).

integration_gaps_and_blockers.description: Missing OWASP security headers (X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, Referrer-Policy).
integration_gaps_and_blockers.remediation: Add a lightweight SecurityHeadersMiddleware in app/middleware/.

integration_gaps_and_blockers.description: Absence of a unified multi-stage End-to-End (E2E) integration test covering the complete customer journey from registration to invoice settlement.
integration_gaps_and_blockers.remediation: Implement tests/test_e2e_lifecycle.py executing the full multi-phase lifecycle end-to-end.

integration_gaps_and_blockers.description: Tests run directly against the live development PostgreSQL database without a dedicated conftest.py transaction rollback fixture.
integration_gaps_and_blockers.remediation: Configure pytest fixture in tests/conftest.py wrapping each test in an isolated rolled-back database transaction.

recommended_next_task: Implement Step 18: Security Hardening (Auth rate limiting + Security Headers), Test Database Fixture Isolation, and Full-Lifecycle End-to-End Integration Suite.
